hooks.name: New File Compliance Reminder
hooks.description: Checks task scope, project tracking, credentials, and dependency records when a file is created.

action.prompt: Review the newly created file against the owner's current task and the current local-web implementation. The agreed product order is website, phone app, phone AR, then VR. Do not call future work implemented. Check that the file belongs in the project and is not scratch output, a chat log, an attribution watermark, an unnecessary agent profile, or an empty evidence folder. If it is inside .kiro, use Git status and check-ignore --no-index to distinguish new files awaiting staging from ignored configuration; do not stage or commit automatically. For credentials, report only paths and line numbers, never values; environment placeholders are allowed. If a real dependency was added, record its pinned version and license in .kiro/steering/project-overview.md. Keep reports in the conversation and speak only about an actual issue.
